ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

Hash.description: HogQL template defining the dedup/grouping key, e.g. {person.id} (once per person within Ttl).

Ttl.description: Seconds (60 to 94608000) to suppress repeat firings of the same hash.

Threshold.description: Fire once per N matches of the same hash within Ttl (a sampler: N=3 fires on the 1st, 4th, 7th match). Omit to fire on the first match, then suppress repeats within Ttl.

Count.description: Maximum number of emails this workflow sends per period.

Period.description: Window the count applies to. Sends over the limit are delayed until capacity frees up, not dropped.
